results.title: Near Light
results.overview: Divorced and out of work, a village schoolteacher tries to recover a lost sense of closeness with other people. She offers a former pupil a driving lesson. Their brief encounter will change how both of them see the world.

results.title: The Language of Their Dreams
results.overview: In a public park in Noisy-le-Grand, children speak about their dreams orally and in sign language. In small groups, they listen to each other in a language made of words, gestures and looks. Behind the park’s walls, the city feeds their imagination.

results.title: Status B
results.overview: Three would-be lovers meet in a military hospital.

results.title: Arina
results.overview: When fidelity has lost its meaning and love has turned into dependence, betrayal becomes a feat. The story of an artist who is looking for peace within, after war has knocked at her door.

results.title: When You See It
results.overview: While filming the pilot episode of a new indie reality ghost hunting show two ghost hunters question if the paranormal activity they are experiencing is real or an elaborate hoax put on by their fame seeking host.

results.title: Night of the Screaming Terror
results.overview: Night Of The Screaming Terror follows Dr Redfern as he visits St Peters mental asylum for the criminally insane. Inside he meets the eccentric Dr Mountford and his group of special patients. Each one with a bizarre and terrifying reason for their eternal detainment in the dark corridors of the asylum.

results.title: Null Adjustments
results.overview: Null Adjustments follows the repair of the Buchla 100 at the Library of Congress, an early modular synthesizer built by Don Buchla for composer Morton Subotnick, who used it to create Silver Apples of the Moon. Shot on 16mm film and employing optical printing techniques, the film pays homage to the instrument’s emergence in the 1960s and showcases its continued playability today.

results.title: Vorfreude
results.overview: Vorfreude (Foresight) is a short experimental film that drifts through the charged space before arrival. Woven from glitching images and analogue video and audio synthesis, it moves less like a journey toward something than like a figure wandering through their own anticipation, tracing and retracing the same trembling edges of feeling without ever quite touching what lies ahead.

results.title: Spinoza’s Rainbow 1
results.overview: A prelude introduces the algebraic calculation of a rainbow’s arc, reputed to be by Baruch Spinoza and dating back to 1687. A shadow observes itself, connecting two points. Through a series of single, double and triple exposures, the three colour records of 16mm film emulsion converge and diverge. Breath becomes a source of movement, and language transforms into frequencies, as if they could become light, through the recitation of three poems by Friedrich Nietzsche from 1887.

results.title: A Way of Listening to the World
results.overview: A Way of Listening to the World is a sound and visual journey built from field recordings and original music. Birds, voices, transportation and machines compose a fragmented listening experience where reality becomes a sensitive material. The film explores liminal spaces between presence and absence, environment and memory.

results.title: Domestic weights and measures
results.overview: An almost diary, featuring cats and bats, a hearse and horses, and much animation. Backdropped by a community arts project, the “our planet in motion” orrery kit and a new take on timelapse. All elements locally sourced. Experimentally friendly and audience curious.

results.title: ABEL
results.overview: "It was kind of a surprising, surprising event…”

results.title: Millstone
results.overview: Millstone takes its cue from the workers’ steady, exact grinding—motion as endurance. Projection, workshop tools and mirrors made during the Cultural Revolution assemble into a site-responsive “vision machine” that settles inside the workshop and learns its rhythm. The objects collaborate, but they also scrape and strain against one another, marking the space with traces—of desire, of longing. Out of this labouring friction, a live-captured interactive image is projected back into the room, calling up a spectre of shared memory.

results.title: Arco Voltaico
results.overview: Arco Voltaico explores the hidden life of a hydroelectric power station deep in the Swiss mountains. We are guided from the darkness into the pulsating heart of the facility, among massive conduits, towering turbines and a silent, unsettling control centre. We observe the annual procedure of magnetic particle inspection: a complex examination of the turbines aimed at detecting cracks and material defects. Through the technicians’ hands and their meticulous application of magnets and fluorescent powders, we follow every stage of the inspection, an open-heart exploration of the machine. The soundscape, built from recordings captured inside the plant, transforms the environment into an auditory landscape that makes the invisible presence of energy and technology tangible. Amid flashes of iridescent light and metallic reflections, Arco Voltaico reveals the delicate interplay between humans and machinery, fragility and power.

results.title: The Signalman
results.overview: "A man must be obedient to the signs," says railway signalman and poet Ezra Miles. This film is poetic journey into his thoughts from a box about mental health and the divine.

results.title: sixty beats
results.overview: A forensic filming of a 1829 Vuillamy turret clock still beating within a crumbling colonial era tower. The infliction of this steam age time machine is illuminated by the natural rhythms of piercing daylight.

results.title: Acciaio
results.overview: In the landscape of Monte Amiata, organic memory and industrial presence merge. The traces of human activity settle into nature like silent apparitions, blurring the boundaries between the man-made and living matter.

results.title: Meadow
results.overview: During a cabin getaway, a young woman facing an unexpected pregnancy begins to experience unsettling visions that blur the line between reality and something darker.

results.title: Cathexis
results.overview: In a forgotten Florida panhandle town, a lonely young woman responsible for a murder becomes fixated on inhabiting the mind of the case’s detective as fantasy and reality begin to blur.

results.title: Chronically Radical – Behindert, verrückt, Taub im Widerstand
results.original_title: Chronically Radical – Behindert, verrückt, Taub im Widerstand
results.overview: This documentary follows people with chronic illnesses, the deaf, neurodivergent individuals, and people with disabilities as they engage in political activism. Whether in Lützerath, at protests against the automotive industry, or at ­ networking events, they speak out about exclusion and the lack of awareness regarding their life situations, while also highlighting ideas and opportunities to break down ableist structures.
